considered, not kept.concept: Register-file access routing and write control
considered, not kept.reason: The rf_* fields, derived write enable, and register addresses only specify which register access occurs or whether written data is accepted, so the access-command-field rule bars them as separate concepts (lines 76-80, 109 and 126-127).
The instruction field and rs3_addr only select the register value returned on rs3_o and do not hold an independent security-relevant state (lines 141 and 144).
RST_EN, RVE_EN and RS3_EN are build-time generics that select implementation structure and cannot be changed or withheld at run time (lines 31-35, 68, 98, 136 and 147).
Clock and reset inputs are excluded from conceptual assets by the clock-and-reset rule.
